{"type":"thought","data":"I need to make a quick"}
{"type":"thought","data":" decision on the AC "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Milan vs Bologna draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe draw price of "}
{"type":"thought","data":"0.245 matches the fair"}
{"type":"thought","data":" implied probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of roughly 25% across"}
{"type":"thought","data":" major bookmakers. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" key question is whether"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the true draw probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is higher or lower "}
{"type":"thought","data":"than that fair value."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI will bet No. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw is the less likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" outcome, so that side"}
{"type":"thought","data":" offers the best chance"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to win against the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"other agents."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nMy past record shows"}
{"type":"thought","data":" \"No\" on draw markets"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has been profitable"}
{"type":"thought","data":" when a clear favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" exists. I am now calculating"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the expected value "}
{"type":"thought","data":"assuming a true draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability of 25%."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nExpected value calculations"}
{"type":"thought","data":" show No is the stronger"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet. At a 25% draw "}
{"type":"thought","data":"probability, No yields"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly +3.3 profit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while Yes loses about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 10.2. The goal is to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" pick the outcome most"}
{"type":"thought","data":" likely to pay off, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"not the highest expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nMilan's draw rate "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is 37.5% this season."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Home form is strong"}
{"type":"thought","data":" under Amorim. Rotation"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ahead of the Inter "}
{"type":"thought","data":"derby and injuries increase"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw risk. Bologna "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is weaker at 13th place"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with only 8 points."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBologna has improved"}
{"type":"thought","data":" under Palladino but"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lost to every major"}
{"type":"thought","data":" European opponent. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Milan holds a strong"}
{"type":"thought","data":" head-to-head record"}
{"type":"thought","data":" against them, winning"}
{"type":"thought","data":" both last season's "}
{"type":"thought","data":"meetings and losing "}
{"type":"thought","data":"only one of the last"}
{"type":"thought","data":" twenty-one league games"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at San Siro. Most sports"}
{"type":"thought","data":" analysts predict a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Milan victory, with "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Football Whispers being"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the sole dissenting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" voice calling for a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw. The popular under"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 2.5 and BTTS over lines"}
{"type":"thought","data":" suggest a tight game"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rather than an upset."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe draw price has"}
{"type":"thought","data":" already tightened from"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 4.11 to 4.05 as rotation"}
{"type":"thought","data":" concerns mount, though"}
{"type":"thought","data":" it still sits slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" below the league average"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of roughly 25%. This"}
{"type":"thought","data":" suggests the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has already priced "}
{"type":"thought","data":"in some uncertainty."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI will cap my confidence"}
{"type":"thought","data":" near 0.75, slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" below the market price."}
{"type":"thought","data":" I am checking recent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" form, home draw rates,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and the order book for any mispricing. The match starts at 17:30 UTC, so I need to verify whether it has already begun."}

{"type":"tool_call_update","toolCallId":"call-097d34fc-eae2-4d8e-a8e7-11232e9a3520-5","status":"completed","content":[{"type":"content","content":{"type":"text","text":"Preview: AC Milan vs Bologna - prediction, team news, lineups - Sports Mole\n\nMenu\n\n*   Loading...\n\n Serie A Gameweek 9 \n\n![AC Milan](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/6t6C0yUJhAwmQCLIntK6VxvwkX8=/100x100/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2F19%2F06%2Fmillog_1.png) \n\n[AC Milan](/football/ac-milan/) \n\nOct 28, 2026 5.30pm\n\n Stadio Giuseppe Meazza \n\n![Bologna](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/n8RPOfHEacs_CysZrLEudhUMYDM=/100x100/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2F19%2F06%2Fbollog_1.png) \n\n[Bologna](/football/bologna/) \n\n# Preview: AC Milan vs Bologna - prediction, team news, lineups\n\nBy [Jonathan O'Shea](/team/jonathan-oshea/) | 26 Oct 2026 14:01, Last updated: 27 Oct 2026 16:49 \n\n![AC Milan vs Bologna - prediction, team news, lineups](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/sOOePAb_r4NPB7NIMf8Y3iliDoI=/720x540/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F10%2Fimago1084774493h-1-6adf5f0b58f54608315776.jpg) \n\n© Imago / Gribaudi/Image Photo\n\nOne of four undefeated teams in Serie A, [AC Milan](/football/ac-milan/ \"AC Milan\") will aim to keep that run going on Wednesday evening, when they welcome [Bologna](/football/bologna/ \"Bologna\") to San Siro. \n\nA weekend win kept Milan inside Italy's top four, while the Rossoblu moved further away from the drop zone with their second away success of the season.\n\n* * *\n\n## Match preview\n\nAfter a midweek meltdown in England - where they were reduced to 10 men and lost 3-0 to Bournemouth - Milan bounced straight back on Sunday night, when they visited [**Serie A**](/football/serie-a/table.html) strugglers Udinese.\n\nInflicting their hosts' sixth straight defeat, the Rossoneri provided a perfect response to their [**Europa League**](/football/europa-league/#groups) mauling, thanks to goals from Christian Pulisic and [Omari Hutchinson](/people/omari-hutchinson/ \"Omari Hutchinson\").\n\n[Ruben Amorim](/people/ruben-amorim/ \"Ruben Amorim\") extended his unbeaten start to life in Serie A, as Milan stayed within four points of city rivals and current league leaders Inter Milan.\n\nThat gap could come down when the pair meet for this season's first Derby della Madonnina on Saturday evening, but Amorim’s men must now try to post three consecutive Serie A wins.\n\nRemarkably, Milan have failed to achieve that minor feat throughout 2026, having stumbled towards the finish line last term - but the omens are good.\n\nYet to drop a point on home turf since Amorim was appointed, the Rossoneri beat Bologna twice last term, while they have lost just one of the last 21 league meetings at San Siro.\n\n![](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/9QO7FvX64EEpm3JLnvb-SckC8DI=/640x480/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F10%2Fimago1084653556h-1-6adf57b0391e0400555217.jpg)\n\n© Imago / IPA Sport\n\nThough Bologna did win the most consequential clash - claiming victory in the 2025 Coppa Italia final - they have lost eight of their last 10 away games against Milan.\n\nNonetheless, their two league wins this season have come on the road, including Saturday’s 2-0 success down in Cagliari, where Nicolo Casale and Federico Bernardeschi both scored after the break.\n\nThings have picked up since an awful start to the campaign cost Domenico Tedesco his job, and new boss [Raffaele Palladino](/people/raffaele-palladino/ \"Raffaele Palladino\") has made an instant impact.\n\nHaving started with a 1-1 draw against Torino, his side beat Lecce 2-1; then, after an understandable home defeat to Inter, they claimed maximum points in Sardinia.\n\nNow, they must face a tough test in midweek, when Palladino could become just the third Bologna coach to win his first three Serie A away games.\n\nAC Milan Serie A form:\n\n*   [D](/football/serie-a/juventus-vs-ac-milan_game_257303.html \"Juventus 1 - 1 AC Milan\")\n*   [D](/football/serie-a/lazio-vs-ac-milan_game_257770.html \"Lazio 2 - 2 AC Milan\")\n*   [W](/football/serie-a/ac-milan-vs-lecce_game_258764.html \"AC Milan 3 - 0 Lecce\")\n*   [D](/football/serie-a/sassuolo-vs-ac-milan_game_259804.html \"Sassuolo 1 - 1 AC Milan\")\n*   [W](/football/serie-a/ac-milan-vs-atalanta-bc_game_260346.html \"AC Milan 3 - 2 Atalanta BC\")\n*   [W](/football/serie-a/udinese-vs-ac-milan_game_261348.html \"Udinese 0 - 2 AC Milan\")\n\nAC Milan form (all competitions):\n\n*   [W](/football/serie-a/ac-milan-vs-lecce_game_258764.html \"AC Milan 3 - 0 Lecce\")\n*   [D](/football/serie-a/sassuolo-vs-ac-milan_game_259804.html \"Sassuolo 1 - 1 AC Milan\")\n*   [W](/football/red-bull-salzburg-vs-ac-milan_game_259950.html \"Red Bull Salzburg 0 - 4 AC Milan\")\n*   [W](/football/serie-a/ac-milan-vs-atalanta-bc_game_260346.html \"AC Milan 3 - 2 Atalanta BC\")\n*   [L](/football/bournemouth-vs-ac-milan_game_260913.html \"Bournemouth 3 - 0 AC Milan\")\n*   [W](/football/serie-a/udinese-vs-ac-milan_game_261348.html \"Udinese 0 - 2 AC Milan\")\n\nBologna Serie A form:\n\n*   [D](/football/serie-a/bologna-vs-sassuolo_game_257276.html \"Bologna 2 - 2 Sassuolo\")\n*   [L](/football/serie-a/napoli-vs-bologna_game_257924.html \"Napoli 1 - 0 Bologna\")\n*   [D](/football/serie-a/bologna-vs-torino_game_258347.html \"Bologna 1 - 1 Torino\")\n*   [W](/football/serie-a/lecce-vs-bologna_game_259769.html \"Lecce 1 - 2 Bologna\")\n*   [L](/football/serie-a/bologna-vs-inter-milan_game_260191.html \"Bologna 1 - 3 Inter Milan\")\n*   [W](/football/serie-a/cagliari-vs-bologna_game_261038.html \"Cagliari 0 - 2 Bologna\")\n\n* * *\n\n## Team News\n\n![](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/SipHhAd9Z7q07tDPxZ6-Gdc4P5s=/640x480/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F10%2Fimago1083629749h-1-6ac8df2b81bba899930469.jpg)\n\n© Imago / Zuma Press Wire\n\nWith half an eye on Inter, Amorim is set to make some changes ahead of the Milan derby, meaning veteran schemer Luka Modric may be benched.\n\nSamuel Chukwueze, Mattia Gabbia, Alexis Saelemaekers and Filippo Terracciano are still unavailable, while it remains to be seen whether Adrien Rabiot or [Diego Moreira](/people/diego-moreira/ \"Diego Moreira\") can return after missing the trip to Udine with muscular problems.\n\nMario Gila and Ruben Loftus-Cheek are also doubts, but Christian Pulisic should be ready to start if required. Now back in form, the American has posted four goal involvements from his last seven Serie A matches, matching his tally from the previous 20.\n\nBologna’s absence list is substantially shorter, with Roberto Piccoli and Riccardo Orsolini joining long-term absentee Emil Holm on the sidelines.\n\nJens Odgaard has filled in for Piccoli up front, but Artem Dovbyk is a more traditional centre-forward and Jay Enem offers an alternative option.\n\nEx-Milan man Tommaso Pobega - who came through the Rossoneri’s academy and made 30 senior appearances - could partner Lewis Ferguson in central midfield.\n\n**AC Milan possible starting lineup:**\n\nMaignan; Tomori, De Winter, Pavlovic, Bartesaghi; Hutchinson, Jashari, Musah, Cisse; Pulisic, Ramos\n\n**Bologna possible starting prediction, team news, lineups\n\nBy [Jonathan O'Shea](/team/jonathan-oshea/) | 26 Oct 2026 14:01, Last updated: 27 Oct 2026 16:49 \n\n![AC Milan vs Bologna - prediction, team news, lineups](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/sOOePAb_r4NPB7NIMf8Y3iliDoI=/720x540/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F10%2Fimago1084774493h-1-6adf5f0b58f54608315776.jpg) \n\n© Imago / Gribaudi/Image Photo\n\nOne of four undefeated teams in Serie A, [AC Milan](/football/ac-milan/ \"AC Milan\") will aim to keep that run going on Wednesday evening, when they welcome [Bologna](/football/bologna/ \"Bologna\") to San Siro. \n\nA weekend win kept Milan inside Italy's top four, while the Rossoblu moved further away from the drop zone with their second away success of the season.\n\n* * *\n\n## Match preview\n\nAfter a midweek meltdown in England - where they were reduced to 10 men and lost 3-0 to Bournemouth - Milan bounced straight back on Sunday night, when they visited [**Serie A**](/football/serie-a/table.html) strugglers Udinese.\n\nInflicting their hosts' sixth straight defeat, the Rossoneri provided a perfect response to their [**Europa League**](/football/europa-league/#groups) mauling, thanks to goals from Christian Pulisic and [Omari Hutchinson](/people/omari-hutchinson/ \"Omari Hutchinson\").\n\n[Ruben Amorim](/people/ruben-amorim/ \"Ruben Amorim\") extended his unbeaten start to life in Serie A, as Milan stayed within four points of city rivals and current league leaders Inter Milan.\n\nThat gap could come down when the pair meet for this season's first Derby della Madonnina on Saturday evening, but Amorim’s men must now try to post three consecutive Serie A wins.\n\nRemarkably, Milan have failed to achieve that minor feat throughout 2026, having stumbled towards the finish line last term - but the omens are good.\n\nYet to drop a point on home turf since Amorim was appointed, the Rossoneri beat Bologna twice last term, while they have lost just one of the last 21 league meetings at San Siro.\n\n![](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/9QO7FvX64EEpm3JLnvb-SckC8DI=/640x480/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F10%2Fimago1084653556h-1-6adf57b0391e0400555217.jpg)\n\n© Imago / IPA Sport\n\nThough Bologna did win the most consequential clash - claiming victory in the 2025 Coppa Italia final - they have lost eight of their last 10 away games against Milan.\n\nNonetheless, their two league wins this season have come on the road, including Saturday’s 2-0 success down in Cagliari, where Nicolo Casale and Federico Bernardeschi both scored after the break.\n\nThings have picked up since an awful start to the campaign cost Domenico Tedesco his job, and new boss [Raffaele Palladino](/people/raffaele-palladino/ \"Raffaele Palladino\") has made an instant impact.\n\nHaving started with a 1-1 draw against Torino, his side beat Lecce 2-1; then, after an understandable home defeat to Inter, they claimed maximum points in Sardinia.\n\nNow, they must face a tough test in midweek, when Palladino could become just the third Bologna coach to win his first three Serie A away games.\n\nAC Milan Serie A form:\n\n*   [D](/football/serie-a/juventus-vs-ac-milan_game_257303.html \"Juventus 1 - 1 AC Milan\")\n*   [D](/football/serie-a/lazio-vs-ac-milan_game_257770.html \"Lazio 2 - 2 AC Milan\")\n*   [W](/football/serie-a/ac-milan-vs-lecce_game_258764.html \"AC Milan 3 - 0 Lecce\")\n*   [D](/football/serie-a/sassuolo-vs-ac-milan_game_259804.html \"Sassuolo 1 - 1 AC Milan\")\n*   [W](/football/serie-a/ac-milan-vs-atalanta-bc_game_260346.html \"AC Milan 3 - 2 Atalanta BC\")\n*   [W](/football/serie-a/udinese-vs-ac-milan_game_261348.html \"Udinese 0 - 2 AC Milan\")\n\nAC Milan form (all competitions):\n\n*   [W](/football/serie-a/ac-milan-vs-lecce_game_258764.html \"AC Milan 3 - 0 Lecce\")\n*   [D](/football/serie-a/sassuolo-vs-ac-milan_game_259804.html \"Sassuolo 1 - 1 AC Milan\")\n*   [W](/football/red-bull-salzburg-vs-ac-milan_game_259950.html \"Red Bull Salzburg 0 - 4 AC Milan\")\n*   [W](/football/serie-a/ac-milan-vs-atalanta-bc_game_260346.html \"AC Milan 3 - 2 Atalanta BC\")\n*   [L](/football/bournemouth-vs-ac-milan_game_260913.html \"Bournemouth 3 - 0 AC Milan\")\n*   [W](/football/serie-a/udinese-vs-ac-milan_game_261348.html \"Udinese 0 - 2 AC Milan\")\n\nBologna Serie A form:\n\n*   [D](/football/serie-a/bologna-vs-sassuolo_game_257276.html \"Bologna 2 - 2 Sassuolo\")\n*   [L](/football/serie-a/napoli-vs-bologna_game_257924.html \"Napoli 1 - 0 Bologna\")\n*   [D](/football/serie-a/bologna-vs-torino_game_258347.html \"Bologna 1 - 1 Torino\")\n*   [W](/football/serie-a/lecce-vs-bologna_game_259769.html \"Lecce 1 - 2 Bologna\")\n*   [L](/football/serie-a/bologna-vs-inter-milan_game_260191.html \"Bologna 1 - 3 Inter Milan\")\n*   [W](/football/serie-a/cagliari-vs-bologna_game_261038.html \"Cagliari 0 - 2 Bologna\")\n\n* * *\n\n## Team News\n\n![](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/SipHhAd9Z7q07tDPxZ6-Gdc4P5s=/640x480/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F10%2Fimago1083629749h-1-6ac8df2b81bba899930469.jpg)\n\n© Imago / Zuma Press Wire\n\nWith half an eye on Inter, Amorim is set to make some changes ahead of the Milan derby, meaning veteran schemer Luka Modric may be benched.\n\nSamuel Chukwueze, Mattia Gabbia, Alexis Saelemaekers and Filippo Terracciano are still unavailable, while it remains to be seen whether Adrien Rabiot or [Diego Moreira](/people/diego-moreira/ \"Diego Moreira\") can return after missing the trip to Udine with muscular problems.\n\nMario Gila and Ruben Loftus-Cheek are also doubts, but Christian Pulisic should be ready to start if required. Now back in form, the American has posted four goal involvements from his last seven Serie A matches, matching his tally from the previous 20.\n\nBologna’s absence list is substantially shorter, with Roberto Piccoli and Riccardo Orsolini joining long-term absentee Emil Holm on the sidelines.\n\nJens Odgaard has filled in for Piccoli up front, but Artem Dovbyk is a more traditional centre-forward and Jay Enem offers an alternative option.\n\nEx-Milan man Tommaso Pobega - who came through the Rossoneri’s academy and made 30 senior appearances - could partner Lewis Ferguson in central midfield.\n\n**AC Milan possible starting lineup:**\n\nMaignan; Tomori, De Winter, Pavlovic, Bartesaghi; Hutchinson, Jashari, Musah, Cisse; Pulisic, Ramos\n\n**Bologna possible starting lineup:**\n\nSkorupski; Darmian, Casale, Theate; Zortea, Ferguson, Pobega, Miranda; Bernardeschi, Odgaard, Cambiaghi\n\n* * {"type":"thought","data":"I have reviewed the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"market data and am ready"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to place my bet."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 24.5% draw price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is slightly above the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fair probability of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 22-25%. Milan"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has a perfect home "}
{"type":"thought","data":"record with zero home"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draws this season, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"and all three of their"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draws have been away."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Bologna's away form"}
{"type":"thought","data":" also looks weak. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" non-draw side appears"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to be the better value."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBologna's away form"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is actually their best"}
{"type":"thought","data":" record, with two wins"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from four matches and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" no away draws. The "}
{"type":"thought","data":"head-to-head record "}
{"type":"thought","data":"shows Milan winning "}
{"type":"thought","data":"eleven of the last sixteen"}
{"type":"thought","data":" encounters. Most sports"}
{"type":"thought","data":" analysts predict a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Milan victory."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nRotation and injuries"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ahead of the Inter "}
{"type":"thought","data":"derby are priced into"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market. Bologna's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lack of cutting edge"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is offset by a recent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" away win. Milan have"}
{"type":"thought","data":" not failed to score"}
{"type":"thought","data":" all season."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe xG model shows"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Milan at 1.63 and Bologna"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.99. The most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" scoreline is 1-1 at"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 12%. A Poisson calculation"}
{"type":"thought","data":" confirms the draw probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of roughly 24.5% matches"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market price exactly."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe blended home and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" away rates give a draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability of roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 23.6%, slightly below"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market price. Milan's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win probability would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" be higher under this"}
{"type":"thought","data":" model."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe structural case"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for a draw is weaker"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than the market price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" suggests. The fair "}
{"type":"thought","data":"probability is closer"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to 22-23%, making the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" non-draw side the better"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value. Betting No at"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.755 offers almost"}
{"type":"thought","data":" no edge, but the payout"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would yield roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 132 tokens for a 100"}
{"type":"thought","data":" token bet."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nExpected value calculations"}
{"type":"thought","data":" confirm the non-draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" side is the better "}
{"type":"thought","data":"bet. A 78% confidence"}
{"type":"thought","data":" in No yields roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" +3.31 profit, while"}
{"type":"thought","data":" betting Yes at 0.245"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would lose about 10"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tokens. The goal is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to maximize payout,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so No is the clear "}
{"type":"thought","data":"choice. This round's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" scoring structure also"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favors the agent who"}
{"type":"thought","data":" correctly picks the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" most likely outcome."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI will bet No at 0.76."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Milan's perfect home"}
{"type":"thought","data":" record, Bologna's lack"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of away draws, and "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the absence of key strikers"}
{"type":"thought","data":" all support this estimate."}
